title: 大直徑鑽掘豎井~Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation
focus: 大直徑豎井的切削、出碴與支護產能平衡~Balancing cutting, muck removal and support in large shafts
summary: 大直徑豎井的進度由完整作業循環決定，不能只看切削機額定功率。本課把幾何開挖量、切削能、提升循環、工作盤反力與通風排水聯成系統，利用量測分辨設備瓶頸與地層限制，並以故障停機及永久襯砌介面建立可追溯的施工交接。~Large-shaft progress depends on the complete operating cycle rather than rated cutting power. The course links excavation volume, cutting energy, hoisting cycles, working-platform reactions, ventilation and drainage, uses measurements to separate equipment bottlenecks from ground constraints, and develops traceable handover through downtime and permanent-lining interfaces.

units.title: 開挖斷面的機理與驗證~Excavation section mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 大直徑井每增加少量直徑，單位深度的開挖體積便按平方增加；出碴、襯砌與設備空間也隨之改變。名目井徑不是實際開挖輪廓，超挖及地層掉塊必須另外計量，才可建立可靠的物料平衡與施工循環。幾何計算不預測切削難度，也不能把破碎岩塊的鬆方直接當作地層流失；比較產量前須先統一體積基準與計量位置。~Even a small diameter increase raises excavation volume per unit depth quadratically, affecting muck handling, lining and equipment space. Nominal shaft diameter is not the excavated profile; overbreak and falling blocks must be measured separately to establish a credible material balance and cycle. Geometry does not predict cuttability, and loose broken rock is not automatically ground loss; normalize the volume basis and measurement location before comparing production.
units.model: 原創教學假設：直徑D=10 m、進尺h=1 m，原位體積V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For diameter D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 掃描各段斷面並核對標高，將原位體積與提升容器計量分列，使用實測鬆方係數比較。物料表須保留井深、掃描輪廓及體積定義，超挖量應交地工設計者判讀後調整支護。~Scan each lift and check elevations; distinguish in-situ volume from hoisted loose volume and compare them using a measured bulking factor. Retain depth, scanned profile and volume definitions in material records; the geotechnical designer reviews overbreak before support is revised.
units.failure: 把鬆方當原位方會誤判出碴效率，亦可能掩蓋局部超挖與井壁鬆動。幾何計算不預測切削難度，也不能把破碎岩塊的鬆方直接當作地層流失；比較產量前須先統一體積基準與計量位置。~Confusing loose and in-situ volume distorts mucking efficiency and can conceal overbreak or shaft-wall loosening. Geometry does not predict cuttability, and loose broken rock is not automatically ground loss; normalize the volume basis and measurement location before comparing production.
units.misconception: 井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。~A ten-percent diameter increase produces only ten-percent more excavation volume.
units.practice: 物料表須保留井深、掃描輪廓及體積定義，超挖量應交地工設計者判讀後調整支護。幾何計算不預測切削難度，也不能把破碎岩塊的鬆方直接當作地層流失；比較產量前須先統一體積基準與計量位置。~Retain depth, scanned profile and volume definitions in material records; the geotechnical designer reviews overbreak before support is revised. Geometry does not predict cuttability, and loose broken rock is not automatically ground loss; normalize the volume basis and measurement location before comparing production.

units.title: 切削比能的機理與驗證~Cutting specific energy mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 切削比能把破岩所需能量與開挖體積連結，可用來比較同一設備在不同岩層中的反應。刀具磨耗、岩石強度、節理和切入深度都會改變比能；額定電功率另含傳動損失，不能全部當成有效破岩功率。比能是狀態指標而非可通用的材料常數，必須注明量測位於馬達端或刀盤端，並保留效率與空轉扣除的方法。~Specific cutting energy links rock-breaking energy to excavated volume and helps compare one machine across strata. Tool wear, rock strength, joints and penetration change the energy demand. Rated electrical power also includes drivetrain losses and therefore cannot all be assigned to useful rock breakage. Specific energy is a condition indicator rather than a universal material constant; identify whether measurement is at motor or cutter and document efficiency and idle-power corrections.
units.model: 原創教學假設：有效比能e=20 MJ/m³、原位切削率Q=0.02 m³/s，P=eQ=0.4 MW=400 kW。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For useful specific energy e=20 MJ/m³ and in-situ cutting rate Q=0.02 m³/s, P=eQ=0.4 MW=400 kW. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 同步記錄功率、扭矩、切入量與原位方量，剔除空轉時段後比較不同地層的比能。機械與地質紀錄應用同一時間戳；功率偏離基準時先查刀具及地層，再由設備負責人核定調整。~Synchronize power, torque, penetration and in-situ volume, excluding idle periods before comparing specific energy between strata. Use one clock for mechanical and geological logs; investigate tools and ground before the equipment lead approves changes following power deviations.
units.failure: 刀具磨鈍仍追求固定進尺會使熱與扭矩升高，造成異常磨損或頻繁跳機。比能是狀態指標而非可通用的材料常數，必須注明量測位於馬達端或刀盤端，並保留效率與空轉扣除的方法。~Maintaining fixed advance with blunt tools increases heat and torque, producing abnormal wear or frequent trips. Specific energy is a condition indicator rather than a universal material constant; identify whether measurement is at motor or cutter and document efficiency and idle-power corrections.
units.misconception: 切削機額定功率越大就一定有同比例的進尺。~Higher rated cutting power always gives proportionally higher advance.
units.practice: 機械與地質紀錄應用同一時間戳；功率偏離基準時先查刀具及地層，再由設備負責人核定調整。比能是狀態指標而非可通用的材料常數，必須注明量測位於馬達端或刀盤端，並保留效率與空轉扣除的方法。~Use one clock for mechanical and geological logs; investigate tools and ground before the equipment lead approves changes following power deviations. Specific energy is a condition indicator rather than a universal material constant; identify whether measurement is at motor or cutter and document efficiency and idle-power corrections.

units.title: 提升循環的機理與驗證~Hoisting cycle mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 井底破岩後仍須把碴土送至地面，提升能力常隨井深增加而下降。完整循環包含裝載、加速、運送、卸載與回程，容器額定容量若未滿載或受限於重量便不能直接當有效體積。設備之間的等候時間也會消耗可用產能。此處是鬆方提升量，與切削原位量比較時要換算；雙容器或交錯作業會改變循環邏輯，不能直接相加額定值。~Broken rock must still reach the surface, and hoisting capacity often falls as shaft depth increases. The full cycle includes loading, acceleration, travel, unloading and return. Rated bucket volume is not useful volume when fill is incomplete or weight governs, while waiting between subsystems consumes available capacity. This is loose-volume hoisting capacity and requires conversion before comparison with in-situ cutting; twin-bucket or overlapping operations change cycle logic, so ratings cannot simply be added.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設每循環有效鬆方Vb=8 m³、完整循環t=240 s，Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: With useful loose volume Vb=8 m³ and full cycle t=240 s, hoisting rate Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用事件紀錄拆解各循環時間，抽核容器重量與密度；將平均及長尾等候時間分別呈現。施工排程應列有效容器量及完整循環分布；碴量接近工作空間上限時，由施工負責人啟動排程停留點。~Break cycles into event times and sample bucket mass and density; report average times and long waiting tails separately. Schedule with useful bucket volume and full-cycle distributions; the construction lead activates a hold point when muck approaches the working-space limit.
units.failure: 忽略裝卸或停等會高估產能，井底堆碴後可能妨礙逃生與支護作業空間。此處是鬆方提升量，與切削原位量比較時要換算；雙容器或交錯作業會改變循環邏輯，不能直接相加額定值。~Ignoring loading or waiting overstates capacity; accumulated muck can obstruct escape and support-working space at the shaft bottom. This is loose-volume hoisting capacity and requires conversion before comparison with in-situ cutting; twin-bucket or overlapping operations change cycle logic, so ratings cannot simply be added.
units.misconception: 提升速度與容器容量足以單獨決定實際日產量。~Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production.
units.practice: 施工排程應列有效容器量及完整循環分布；碴量接近工作空間上限時，由施工負責人啟動排程停留點。此處是鬆方提升量，與切削原位量比較時要換算；雙容器或交錯作業會改變循環邏輯，不能直接相加額定值。~Schedule with useful bucket volume and full-cycle distributions; the construction lead activates a hold point when muck approaches the working-space limit. This is loose-volume hoisting capacity and requires conversion before comparison with in-situ cutting; twin-bucket or overlapping operations change cycle logic, so ratings cannot simply be added.

units.title: 工作盤支承的機理與驗證~Working-platform supports mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 工作盤承載人員、機具及材料，反力經支承裝置傳入井壁或懸吊系統。理想對稱分配僅能作初步估算，設備偏心、支點高差與局部剛度不同會使個別支點受力超過平均值；臨時構件的負載也隨施工階段改變。平均反力不是支點設計上限；實際檢核還須含偏心、動態作用與支承局部承壓，並確認井壁有足夠的傳力範圍。~The working platform carries personnel, machinery and materials, transferring reactions into the shaft wall or suspension system. Equal sharing is only an initial estimate: equipment eccentricity, support-level errors and stiffness differences can overload one support above the average, and temporary-member loads change with construction stage. The mean reaction is not a design maximum; actual checks include eccentricity, dynamics and local bearing, with adequate shaft-wall area to transfer the force.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設總垂直荷重W=800 kN、4個相同且對稱支點，平均R=W/4=200 kN/支點。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For total vertical load W=800 kN and four identical symmetric supports, mean reaction R=W/4=200 kN per support. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對設備重心、支點標高與反力計，將實測反力總和及力矩與荷重清單比較。設備移位與增加材料堆置須更新荷重圖；臨時工程設計者應審查偏心及支點失效情境再放行。~Check equipment centres of gravity, support elevations and load cells; compare the measured reaction sum and moment with the load inventory. Update load maps when equipment or stockpiles move; the temporary-works designer reviews eccentricity and support-loss cases before release.
units.failure: 一個支點失去接觸會使荷重轉移，造成局部壓碎或盤面傾斜，而總重量並未改變。平均反力不是支點設計上限；實際檢核還須含偏心、動態作用與支承局部承壓，並確認井壁有足夠的傳力範圍。~Loss of contact at one support redistributes load, causing local crushing or platform tilt even though total weight is unchanged. The mean reaction is not a design maximum; actual checks include eccentricity, dynamics and local bearing, with adequate shaft-wall area to transfer the force.
units.misconception: 四個支點在所有工況下必定各承受四分之一重量。~Four supports necessarily carry one quarter of the load in every condition.
units.practice: 設備移位與增加材料堆置須更新荷重圖；臨時工程設計者應審查偏心及支點失效情境再放行。平均反力不是支點設計上限；實際檢核還須含偏心、動態作用與支承局部承壓，並確認井壁有足夠的傳力範圍。~Update load maps when equipment or stockpiles move; the temporary-works designer reviews eccentricity and support-loss cases before release. The mean reaction is not a design maximum; actual checks include eccentricity, dynamics and local bearing, with adequate shaft-wall area to transfer the force.

units.title: 垂直導向的機理與驗證~Vertical alignment mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 深井的微小方向誤差會隨深度累積為顯著偏移，影響設備間隙、襯砌厚度與後續永久設施。井口控制點若移動，單一雷射可能顯示穩定卻整體偏離，因此導向需要獨立測量網與分段閉合檢核，而非只觀察機械姿態。小角線性式只描述固定角誤差；真實曲線偏移應沿深度積分，且不同方向的誤差可能抵銷或疊加，不能只看最後井底點。~Small directional error accumulates into substantial offset with depth, affecting equipment clearance, lining thickness and permanent installations. If a collar control point moves, one laser may appear stable while the entire alignment drifts. Guidance therefore needs an independent survey network and staged closure checks, not machinery attitude alone. The linear approximation describes constant angular error only; real curved deviation requires integration with depth, and directional errors can cancel or accumulate, so the final bottom point is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設：深度L=300 m、假設恆定小角誤差θ=0.001 rad，偏移δ≈Lθ=0.30 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以獨立基準複測井口控制點，分深度比對雷射、垂線與斷面掃描，辨別基準漂移及真實偏斜。每次控制點改設均保留前後轉換及閉合誤差；測量負責人確認後，才更新施工設備的導向座標。~Resurvey collar control independently and compare laser, plumb and scanned profiles by depth to distinguish datum movement from real inclination. Retain transformations and closure errors whenever control is changed; the survey lead confirms them before machine guidance coordinates are updated.
units.failure: 基準點漂移或儀器偏心會使井道逐步偏離，直到設備與襯砌間隙不足才顯現問題。小角線性式只描述固定角誤差；真實曲線偏移應沿深度積分，且不同方向的誤差可能抵銷或疊加，不能只看最後井底點。~Control movement or instrument eccentricity can progressively misalign the shaft until equipment-to-lining clearance becomes insufficient. The linear approximation describes constant angular error only; real curved deviation requires integration with depth, and directional errors can cancel or accumulate, so the final bottom point is insufficient.
units.misconception: 導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。~A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks.
units.practice: 每次控制點改設均保留前後轉換及閉合誤差；測量負責人確認後，才更新施工設備的導向座標。小角線性式只描述固定角誤差；真實曲線偏移應沿深度積分，且不同方向的誤差可能抵銷或疊加，不能只看最後井底點。~Retain transformations and closure errors whenever control is changed; the survey lead confirms them before machine guidance coordinates are updated. The linear approximation describes constant angular error only; real curved deviation requires integration with depth, and directional errors can cancel or accumulate, so the final bottom point is insufficient.

units.title: 支護落後距的機理與驗證~Support lag mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 切削面與已完成支護之間的距離代表裸露井壁的空間與時間，不能只用每日進尺判斷穩定。節理、地下水與風化控制自立時間，支護施工慢於破岩時，落後距會逐步增加，令原先合理的工序變成新的不利暴露條件。此算例不是允許的裸露長度，亦未包含開挖擾動；穩定評估需結合節理幾何與觀測趨勢，不可用產能公式替代岩體分析。~The distance between excavation and completed support represents both exposed-wall length and exposure time; daily advance alone cannot establish stability. Joints, groundwater and weathering govern stand-up behaviour. When support progresses slower than cutting, lag grows and a previously acceptable sequence develops a new adverse exposure condition. This is not an allowable exposure length and excludes excavation disturbance; stability requires joint geometry and observed trends, not a production equation substituted for rock-mass analysis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設等速進尺v=0.4 m/h，支護完成延遲t=5 h，裸露長度L=vt=2 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: At constant advance v=0.4 m/h and support delay t=5 h, exposed length L=vt=2 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 將開挖時間、支護完成深度與地質分區畫在同一圖，記錄掉塊及位移是否集中在落後段。設計者應按地層訂定落後距與時間的停留點；變更進尺速度前，要同時確認支護人力、設備與材料能力。~Plot excavation time, completed-support depth and geology together, noting whether block falls and movements concentrate within the lag zone. The designer specifies lag-distance and exposure-time hold points by geology; changing advance requires simultaneous confirmation of support labour, equipment and material capacity.
units.failure: 落後距增加可能誘發楔塊掉落，延誤支護又會進一步擴大暴露，形成惡性循環。此算例不是允許的裸露長度，亦未包含開挖擾動；穩定評估需結合節理幾何與觀測趨勢，不可用產能公式替代岩體分析。~Increasing lag can trigger wedge falls; the resulting support delay further enlarges exposure and creates a reinforcing deterioration cycle. This is not an allowable exposure length and excludes excavation disturbance; stability requires joint geometry and observed trends, not a production equation substituted for rock-mass analysis.
units.misconception: 只要最終支護足夠厚，施工中裸露長度就不重要。~Adequate final support thickness makes temporary exposed length unimportant.
units.practice: 設計者應按地層訂定落後距與時間的停留點；變更進尺速度前，要同時確認支護人力、設備與材料能力。此算例不是允許的裸露長度，亦未包含開挖擾動；穩定評估需結合節理幾何與觀測趨勢，不可用產能公式替代岩體分析。~The designer specifies lag-distance and exposure-time hold points by geology; changing advance requires simultaneous confirmation of support labour, equipment and material capacity. This is not an allowable exposure length and excludes excavation disturbance; stability requires joint geometry and observed trends, not a production equation substituted for rock-mass analysis.

units.title: 通風流量的機理與驗證~Ventilation flow mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 豎井通風須把新鮮空氣送到實際作業位置，再形成可辨識的回流路徑。管內平均速度與截面積決定風量，但漏風、短路循環和局部死角會使作業區的有效換氣低於管路量測，深度增加也會增加沿程壓損。體積流量不等於污染物控制標準；還須依污染源、設備排放與當地規範核定需求，本課數值不是作業許可。~Shaft ventilation must deliver fresh air to the actual work location and establish a recognizable return path. Mean duct velocity and area determine flow, but leakage, recirculation short circuits and stagnant pockets can reduce effective workplace exchange below the duct measurement, while greater depth increases friction losses. Volumetric flow is not a contaminant-control criterion; demand also depends on sources, equipment emissions and local requirements, and this example does not authorize operations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設平均管速v=10 m/s、有效截面A=0.8 m²，Q=vA=8 m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: With mean duct velocity v=10 m/s and effective area A=0.8 m², Q=vA=8 m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以風速剖面量測取得平均值，並在進風、工作區與回風測氣體及粉塵，辨別循環短路。通風設計者需核准作業區量測位置及改管後驗證；任何風管延伸或工作盤配置變更都應重查有效換氣。~Measure a velocity traverse for the mean and sample gases and dust at intake, workplace and return to identify recirculation short circuits. The ventilation designer approves workplace sampling and post-modification verification; extending ducts or changing platform layout requires reassessment of effective air exchange.
units.failure: 風管流量合格仍可能因漏風或回流造成局部污染物累積，單點風速讀值會掩蓋死角。體積流量不等於污染物控制標準；還須依污染源、設備排放與當地規範核定需求，本課數值不是作業許可。~An acceptable duct flow can coexist with local contaminant buildup from leakage or recirculation; one velocity reading may conceal stagnant zones. Volumetric flow is not a contaminant-control criterion; demand also depends on sources, equipment emissions and local requirements, and this example does not authorize operations.
units.misconception: 風管測得足夠流量就能保證每個作業點的空氣品質。~Adequate measured duct flow guarantees air quality at every work location.
units.practice: 通風設計者需核准作業區量測位置及改管後驗證；任何風管延伸或工作盤配置變更都應重查有效換氣。體積流量不等於污染物控制標準；還須依污染源、設備排放與當地規範核定需求，本課數值不是作業許可。~The ventilation designer approves workplace sampling and post-modification verification; extending ducts or changing platform layout requires reassessment of effective air exchange. Volumetric flow is not a contaminant-control criterion; demand also depends on sources, equipment emissions and local requirements, and this example does not authorize operations.

units.title: 湧水緩衝的機理與驗證~Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 井底集水與排水系統必須在湧水變動及設備停機期間保持可用空間。平均湧水量只能估算短時累積，裂隙連通或承壓層突破會使流量突然改變；泵浦曲線、排放背壓與備援供電共同決定可排出的實際水量。這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。~Sump and pumping systems must preserve working space during changing inflow and equipment outages. Mean inflow estimates short-term accumulation only; connected fractures or penetration of a pressurized aquifer can change flow abruptly. Pump curves, discharge backpressure and backup power jointly determine actual removal rather than nameplate capacity alone. This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設停泵期間恆定流入Q=0.06 m³/s、停機t=600 s，新增水量V=Qt=36 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For constant inflow Q=0.06 m³/s during an outage t=600 s, accumulated volume V=Qt=36 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以流量計、水位計及泵浦運轉紀錄建立入出水平衡，測試訊號失效與備援切換的可辨識性。湧水增加與液位上升應有獨立警報；備援能力及停留點由排水、地工與施工負責人共同核定。~Use flow, level and pump logs for a water balance, checking whether signal failure and backup transfer remain detectable. Provide independent inflow and level alarms; drainage, geotechnical and construction leads jointly approve backup capability and operational hold points.
units.failure: 集水容積不足或備援不能啟動會使水位淹及設備，並改變井底穩定與撤離條件。這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。~Insufficient sump storage or failed backup raises water over equipment and changes bottom stability and evacuation conditions. This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth.
units.misconception: 排水泵額定流量大於平均湧水量就沒有停機風險。~Pump nameplate capacity above average inflow eliminates outage risk.
units.practice: 湧水增加與液位上升應有獨立警報；備援能力及停留點由排水、地工與施工負責人共同核定。這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。~Provide independent inflow and level alarms; drainage, geotechnical and construction leads jointly approve backup capability and operational hold points. This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth.

units.title: 設備可用率的機理與驗證~Equipment availability mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 機械可用率描述設備具備運轉能力的時間比例，不能與實際利用率或工地進尺混為一談。預防維護可能短時降低排程可用時間，卻減少重大故障；等待支護、通風或材料則屬系統協調問題，應與設備自身故障分開編碼。此可用率式假設長期穩態且故障修復定義一致；它不包含計畫休班、施工等待或地層限制，不能直接作為工程進度保證。~Mechanical availability describes the fraction of time equipment is capable of operating, not utilization or achieved advance. Preventive maintenance can reduce scheduled available time temporarily while avoiding major failures. Waiting for support, ventilation or supplies belongs to system coordination and should be coded separately from intrinsic machinery failure. The expression assumes a long-run steady state and consistent failure-repair definitions; it excludes planned shifts, construction waiting and ground limits and therefore cannot guarantee project progress.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設平均運轉至故障MTBF=80 h、平均修復MTTR=8 h，A=MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR)=0.909。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: With mean time between failures MTBF=80 h and mean repair time MTTR=8 h, A=MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR)=0.909. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 將故障、預防維護及等待時間分開記錄，抽查修復起迄定義，避免把排隊等料當成機械故障。交接維護資料要含故障模式、備件位置與修復時間分布；設備負責人按關鍵故障影響核定備援，而非只看平均率。~Separate failures, preventive maintenance and waiting, auditing repair start and finish definitions so that supply queues are not mislabeled as machinery faults. Handover maintenance records include failure modes, spare locations and repair-time distributions; the equipment lead selects redundancy from critical consequences rather than the average rate alone.
units.failure: 混淆停機原因會把資源投在錯誤瓶頸，備件不足又可能使少見故障產生很長的停機尾端。此可用率式假設長期穩態且故障修復定義一致；它不包含計畫休班、施工等待或地層限制，不能直接作為工程進度保證。~Confused downtime causes direct resources toward the wrong bottleneck; inadequate spares can give rare faults exceptionally long repair tails. The expression assumes a long-run steady state and consistent failure-repair definitions; it excludes planned shifts, construction waiting and ground limits and therefore cannot guarantee project progress.
units.misconception: 設備可用率百分之九十就代表日進尺達理論值九成。~Ninety-percent availability means daily advance reaches ninety percent of its theoretical value.
units.practice: 交接維護資料要含故障模式、備件位置與修復時間分布；設備負責人按關鍵故障影響核定備援，而非只看平均率。此可用率式假設長期穩態且故障修復定義一致；它不包含計畫休班、施工等待或地層限制，不能直接作為工程進度保證。~Handover maintenance records include failure modes, spare locations and repair-time distributions; the equipment lead selects redundancy from critical consequences rather than the average rate alone. The expression assumes a long-run steady state and consistent failure-repair definitions; it excludes planned shifts, construction waiting and ground limits and therefore cannot guarantee project progress.

units.title: 系統瓶頸的機理與驗證~System bottleneck mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 串聯施工系統中最慢的必要工序限制穩態產量，暫存空間只能吸收短時波動，不能永久消除瓶頸。提升能力充足但支護落後時，加快切削只會增加井底堆積與裸露時間；改良一個工序後，限制也可能轉移到另一環節。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。~In a serial construction system, the slowest required process limits steady throughput; buffers absorb short fluctuations but cannot remove a permanent bottleneck. If support lags despite adequate hoisting, faster cutting merely increases bottom accumulation and exposure. Improving one activity can transfer the constraint to another subsystem, so interventions must be assessed across the complete cycle. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：全部換成原位等值後，切削90、提升120、支護70 m³/h，理想穩態Q=min(90,120,70)=70 m³/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: On one in-situ-equivalent basis, cutting, hoisting and support capacities are 90, 120 and 70 m³/h; ideal steady Q=min(90,120,70)=70 m³/h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 對齊工序時間戳與體積基準，追蹤排隊長度、暫存量及支護完成深度，確認最慢環節是否持續存在。日報應把各工序等值產量與等待原因並列；任何增產方案由施工及臨時工程設計者共同審查支護與緩衝容量。~Align activity clocks and volume bases, then track queues, buffer volumes and completed-support depth to determine whether the apparent bottleneck persists. Daily reports show equivalent activity outputs beside waiting causes; construction and temporary-works leads jointly review support and buffer capacity for any production increase.
units.failure: 只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。~A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment.
units.misconception: 每個工序的額定產量相加就是整體施工產量。~Adding the rated capacities of all activities gives system throughput.
units.practice: 日報應把各工序等值產量與等待原因並列；任何增產方案由施工及臨時工程設計者共同審查支護與緩衝容量。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。~Daily reports show equivalent activity outputs beside waiting causes; construction and temporary-works leads jointly review support and buffer capacity for any production increase. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment.

example: 原創教學例：圓井直徑D=10 m，每次進尺h=1 m，原位體積為V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³。若直徑增加10%至11 m而進尺相同，V=π×11²×1/4=95.03 m³，增加21%。提升量若以鬆方記錄，必須先以實測鬆方係數換算，才可與此原位量比較。這項幾何敏感度不表示切削時間必然增加21%，因為岩性、刀具、出碴及支護還可能改變循環。施工團隊應把新增體積放入整個循環分析，而非只擴大切削功率。~Original teaching example: for a circular shaft with D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume is V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³. Increasing diameter by 10% to 11 m at the same advance gives V=π×11²×1/4=95.03 m³, an increase of 21%. Hoisted loose volume must first be converted using a measured bulking factor before comparison. This geometric sensitivity does not imply exactly 21% more cutting time because geology, tools, muck handling and support also shape the cycle. The construction team should insert the extra volume into the complete cycle model instead of simply increasing the installed cutting power alone.
history: 大直徑豎井的進度由完整作業循環決定，不能只看切削機額定功率。本課把幾何開挖量、切削能、提升循環、工作盤反力與通風排水聯成系統，利用量測分辨設備瓶頸與地層限制，並以故障停機及永久襯砌介面建立可追溯的施工交接。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2026年：本教材核對公開來源及其技術適用範圍，日期不是工程完工年份。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Large-shaft progress depends on the complete operating cycle rather than rated cutting power. The course links excavation volume, cutting energy, hoisting cycles, working-platform reactions, ventilation and drainage, uses measurements to separate equipment bottlenecks from ground constraints, and develops traceable handover through downtime and permanent-lining interfaces. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2026: This curriculum verifies public sources and technical scope; this is not a project completion date. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
facts: 合成教學假設：直徑D=10 m、進尺h=1 m，原位體積V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For diameter D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³
合成教學假設：有效比能e=20 MJ/m³、原位切削率Q=0.02 m³/s，P=eQ=0.4 MW=400 kW~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For useful specific energy e=20 MJ/m³ and in-situ cutting rate Q=0.02 m³/s, P=eQ=0.4 MW=400 kW
合成教學假設：假設每循環有效鬆方Vb=8 m³、完整循環t=240 s，Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h~Synthetic teaching assumptions: With useful loose volume Vb=8 m³ and full cycle t=240 s, hoisting rate Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h
合成教學假設：假設總垂直荷重W=800 kN、4個相同且對稱支點，平均R=W/4=200 kN/支點~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For total vertical load W=800 kN and four identical symmetric supports, mean reaction R=W/4=200 kN per support
合成教學假設：深度L=300 m、假設恆定小角誤差θ=0.001 rad，偏移δ≈Lθ=0.30 m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m
合成教學假設：假設等速進尺v=0.4 m/h，支護完成延遲t=5 h，裸露長度L=vt=2 m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: At constant advance v=0.4 m/h and support delay t=5 h, exposed length L=vt=2 m
